Stay on asphalt; if on grass, return to the nearby road while advancing when possible. Positive signedRouteProgressPixels means forward; negative means backward. Avoid reversing or oscillating. There is no inertia or steering: keys move the car directly. All actions last 6 frames (0.1 seconds); diagonals have the same total speed as cardinal moves. A fresh observation follows each action.

criteria.up: Move  1 units UP. Initial displacement per frame: x=0, y=-1, multiplied by the current surface speed. Press up.
criteria.down: Move  1 units DOWN. Initial displacement per frame: x=0, y=1, multiplied by the current surface speed. Press down.
criteria.left: Move 1 units LEFT . Initial displacement per frame: x=-1, y=0, multiplied by the current surface speed. Press left.
criteria.right: Move 1 units RIGHT . Initial displacement per frame: x=1, y=0, multiplied by the current surface speed. Press right.
criteria.up+left: Move 0.70711 units LEFT 0.70711 units UP. Initial displacement per frame: x=-0.70711, y=-0.70711, multiplied by the current surface speed. Press up+left.
criteria.up+right: Move 0.70711 units RIGHT 0.70711 units UP. Initial displacement per frame: x=0.70711, y=-0.70711, multiplied by the current surface speed. Press up+right.
criteria.down+left: Move 0.70711 units LEFT 0.70711 units DOWN. Initial displacement per frame: x=-0.70711, y=0.70711, multiplied by the current surface speed. Press down+left.
criteria.down+right: Move 0.70711 units RIGHT 0.70711 units DOWN. Initial displacement per frame: x=0.70711, y=0.70711, multiplied by the current surface speed. Press down+right.
criteria.none: Stop moving. This consumes time without making progress.
